question: What is the name of the Indian athlete who won an Olympic bronze medal in wrestling at the 2016 Rio Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sakshi Malik**__.

**__Key Points__**

__

• **Sakshi Malik** created history at the **2016 Rio Olympics** by becoming the first **Indian female wrestler** to win an Olympic medal.

• She competed in the **women's 58 kg freestyle** category and secured the **bronze medal** after a thrilling 8-5 victory over **Aisuluu Tynybekova** of Kyrgyzstan in the repechage round.

• Her victory was significant as it ended India's **12-day medal drought** during the **Rio Games** and made her the fourth **Indian woman** to win an Olympic medal.

• Hailing from **Rohtak, Haryana**, she was subsequently honored with India's highest sporting honor, the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna**, in **2016**.

 **Additional Information__**

• **Sushil Kumar**:

• He is the first athlete from **independent India** to win **two individual Olympic medals**.

• He won a **bronze medal** at the **2008 Beijing Olympics** and a **silver medal** at the **2012 London Olympics** in the **66 kg freestyle** event.

• **Yogeshwar Dutt**:

• He secured a **bronze medal** at the **2012 London Olympics** in the **60 kg freestyle** wrestling category.

• He was recognized for his contribution to sports with the **Padma Shri** in **2013**.

• **Bajrang Punia**:

• He won a **bronze medal** in the **men's 65 kg freestyle** wrestling at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.

• He is distinguished as the only Indian wrestler to win **four medals** at the **World Wrestling Championships**.
